Frequently Asked Questions

What services do you offer?

I offer a range of digital learning services including eLearning development, instructional design, LMS implementation and administration, curriculum development, and training needs analysis.

How long does a typical eLearning project take?

Project timelines vary based on complexity, scope, and content availability. A simple module might take 2-3 weeks, while a comprehensive curriculum could take several months. During our initial consultation, I'll provide a detailed timeline based on your specific needs.

Do you work with clients internationally?

Yes! I work with clients globally and have experience collaborating with organizations across Africa, Europe, and North America. All meetings can be conducted virtually, and I'm flexible with scheduling across different time zones.

What information do you need to provide a quote?

To provide an accurate quote, I typically need information about your project objectives, target audience, desired outcomes, content availability, timeline, and any specific technical requirements. During our initial consultation, I'll ask targeted questions to understand your needs fully.
